newsitem.title: UK: Robert Fleming details first half results.
newsitem.headline: Robert Fleming details first half results.

text.p: Privately-owned British investment banking group Robert Fleming said on Wednesday that its pretax profit for the six months to the end of September had risen to 92.2 million stg from 79.4 million stg the previous year.

The group said tax payable for the period was 31.2 million stg, compared with 26.4 million stg the previous year. Profit attributable to shareholders was 60.9 million stg, compared with 52.9 million stg for the same period the year before.
Retained profits for the group were 48.9 million stg, compared with 42.5 million stg for the same period in 1995.

Earnings per share were 41.5 pence, compared with 35.8 pence per share a year earlier while net assets per share rose to 516 pence from 486 pence a year before. Net assets per share at the end of March 1996 were 492 pence, Flemings said in a statement.
